clips.title: The story
paras: The Hillsbrad Fields encompass the cultivated farmlands and rustic settlement of Hillsbrad in western Hillsbrad Foothills. As one of the few surviving human communities in former Lordaeron that refused to succumb to the Scourge or join the fanatical Scarlet Crusade, its farmers and militia now face constant assaults from the nearby Forsaken at Tarren Mill.

Spanning orchards, pumpkin patches, and pastures between Darrow Hill and the Azurelode Mine, the Hillsbrad Fields supply essential provisions to Southshore and the surviving Alliance resistance. While much of Lordaeron fell to the plague of undeath, the people of Hillsbrad endured, proudly retaining the royal tabard and heraldry of their fallen kingdom. Led by Magistrate Burnside and the Council of Hillsbrad, the township operates as an independent civic body under constant siege. The local blacksmith Verringtan and his apprentices keep the populace armed, ensuring every farmer and laborer is prepared to defend their land.
